mechanism.base: Water ends fire, the old texts say: the many overcome the few, and rain outlasts any blaze. Heat climbs and spreads wherever it finds fuel, and water is the one thing it cannot consume. Poured over a flame, water does not argue with it. It takes the heat into itself, rises as steam and leaves the ground cool and dark, and every fire that meets water learns its true size.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Water, the blaze meets nothing that can stop it: every plan catches, no fire gets put out, and the heat runs wherever it likes. Take on one deadline someone else sets.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Water, the rain keeps falling on a small flame: every rule weighs more than it should, and the light shrinks to stay lit. Keep one evening a week with nothing due.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Water makes it cool and deep, and a rule settles in quietly. As a catalyst, the pull stays faint and you seldom reach for rank. Rank comes late and by your record.
function.definition_friction: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Water keeps it deep, and rules sink in to stay. As a friction, the rules outweigh what you want. You give up ease to keep them.
function.definition_balanced: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Water makes it cool and deep, and a rule settles in quietly. In balance, the rules you keep are your own choice. Rank comes as the work earns it.
function.advise_catalyst: You do your best work with a date on it and someone waiting at the other end. Ask for honest feedback on one thing you made and just listen. Learn how one new task is done before you start on it. Leave an hour empty between two big jobs.
function.advise_friction: Seek Wood, the Mind energy. Wood is fuel that grows: it drinks the rain and turns it into something a fire can burn. Let it use what Water pours on you. You take every rule to heart faster than you take anything in. Begin one thing this month that is only yours. Keep it off every list.
function.advise_balanced: Your rules stay light while you take in as much as you take on. Ask for honest feedback on one thing you made and just listen. Leave an hour empty between two big jobs.

candidates.cta_verdict: You take a rule in quietly and keep it for years, and you would rather answer to a standard you chose than to a voice raised at you.

catalyst.clause: the blaze meets nothing that can stop it
catalyst.remedy: Take on one deadline someone else sets.

friction.clause: the rain keeps falling on a small flame
friction.remedy: Keep one evening a week with nothing due.

wide.clause: There is no shortage of Water in you, the rain that keeps the blaze its right size.
wide.remedy: Use it. Take the deadline and meet it.

missing.clause: No rain anywhere near the blaze: nothing outside you says when enough is enough.
missing.remedy: Borrow rules: one person above you, one date you did not pick.

spared.clause: No rain falls on this low flame, and better so: nothing is pressing the light out.
spared.remedy: Nothing to ease here. Build the fire up first.

thin.clause: Only a little rain reaches this flame, and the light holds its heat under it.
thin.remedy: Keep it small. Take rules as they come, one at a time.

excess.clause: Water this deep puts a low fire out: so many rules answered that the light itself goes dark.
excess.remedy: Answer fewer demands. Add fuel before the next one.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Duty is your accountability function: how order, obligation, and other people’s depths sit on you. With Water running it, accountability in you arrives quietly: the measured senior, the still question, consequences that seep rather than strike. You answer best to calm authority, and you learn to bank your fire around it. Choose water that cools you without putting you out.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Fire, and Water tames Fire: rain ends the blaze. Water is the cool that presses on you, rules, review, depths you cannot light, and a flame that has met rain burns more carefully ever after. That is why Water is your Order, the discipline that shapes you. Rain is not the end of fire. It is fire’s education.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.action: A cool deadline focuses your flame: pressure quiets the flicker and points the heat.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Water is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is the cool check your intensity needs: reviews, budgets, one person whose calm questions slow you down before the leap. Your best decisions have all survived a night of doubt.

Bold, quick, better with a counterweight. The friend who asks what could go wrong, the budget that will not flex, the rule about sleeping on it: each has quietly saved you more than once, and you know it.

Discipline, for you, is imported, so import it well. Sleep on anything irreversible. Keep a reviewer you cannot charm and show them everything big. Put a cool number on every hot plan before saying yes.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Water is your Order, and as a friction, it is caution soaking through everything: every plan reviewed until the moment passes, every spark second-guessed into a maybe. The checking now costs more than the mistakes would.

Careful, considered, dimmed. The idea gets run past four people and survives none of them, the window closes during the third review, and enthusiasm has learned to arrive pre-apologized.

Prudence past its dose becomes fear with a clipboard. Give small decisions a five-minute timer. Reserve real review for the truly irreversible. Once a month, act on a warm impulse the same day it arrives and audit the result later.
